# v1.0 — Skybound (Minecraft 1.21.1)

First public release of **GrappleMod: Skybound** — a fork of [grapplemod-restitched](https://github.com/squeeglii/grapplemod-restitched) focused on grappling onto **moving structures** (Create contraptions, Sable airships, Create: Aeronautics) with stable multiplayer.

## Highlights

- **Moving-structure support.** Grapple onto Create contraptions, Sable sublevels, and Create: Aeronautics airships. Ropes track position and rotation, survive sublevel splits, and wrap around partial blocks correctly.
- **Server-authoritative multiplayer.** All hook and rope state lives on the server — other players see exactly what you see, hooks survive a relog, and ropes can be cut with shears.
- **Smithing Table upgrades.** Apply motors, rockets, ender teleports, magnets, dual hooks, forcefields, and rope styles via vanilla Smithing.
- **Long Fall Boots.** Land safely after a long swing.
- **Built-in resource pack variants:** classic textures, hook-only, no-enchants, classic recipes.
- **`useLimitedHook` gamerule** for servers that want to restrict where hooks can attach.

## Compatibility

| Mod | Status |
|---|---|
| [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric) | ✅ Grapple onto contraptions |
| [Sable](https://modrinth.com/mod/sable) | ✅ Grapple onto sublevels |
| [Create: Aeronautics](https://github.com/Create-Aeronautics/Create-Aeronautics) | ✅ Via Sable |

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.1**
- Fabric Loader **0.16.14+**
- [YACL](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) **3.8.2+**
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) **11.0.1+**

## Install

Download `grapplemod-1.0+1.21.1.fabric.jar` below and drop it into your `mods/` folder.

## Reporting Issues

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/weaversworkshop/grapplemod-skybound/issues) — please include your Skybound version, MC version, Fabric Loader version, and (if applicable) Create / Sable / Aeronautics versions.
